entities.summary: Spanish art school, museum and gallery in madrid, spain  Originating c. 1752 CE. Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando is a art museum with roots in Europe, arising around 1752-04-12. Attributed to Ferdinand VI of Spain.
